REPORT
Date. May 2, 1936.
Subject. Communication dated April 27, 1936 from British General Staff.
Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by. L. S. J. C. / 7/4
With reference to the attached communication dated
April 27, 1936 from the British General Staff, Shanghai,
enquiries indicate that the newspaper office in question
does not function locally.
A Chinese publishing enterprise, which some two months
ago was located at No. 118 Tsepoo Road near North Honan Road,
but which has now removed to an unknown destination, was
known as "SHIN PO KAN," the nearest approximation to the name
mentioned in the attached letter. No maps, however, were
sold by this concern.
（左侧批注：Dnx' 5/2）
（签名：Ja. Pitts）
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

报告
日期：1936年5月2日。
事由：英国参谋本部1936年4月27日来函。
呈报人：D.S. Pitts。转呈人：L. S. J. C. / 7/4
关于附上的英国驻上海参谋本部1936年4月27日的来函，经查询表明，所涉报社在当地并未运作。
一家中文出版企业，约两个月前位于北河南路附近的芝罘路118号，但现已迁往不明地点，其名称为“申报馆”（SHIN PO KAN），与附件信函中提到的名称最为接近。然而，该机构并不出售地图。
（左侧批注：Dnx' 5/2）
（签名：Ja. Pitts）
D. S.
特务科主管警官。

YBYao）

TEL. 17121
BRITISH GENERAL STAFF
SHANGHAI
27th April, 1936.

Dear A. Robertson,

I am informed that a new map of China
has been published by a newspaper office called
(in Japanese) "Shin Do Kan". In Chinese, this
would probably be "Hsin Tao Kuan" or "Hsin Tung
Kuan".

I would be very grateful if you could
let me know whether you have heard of this paper.

Yours faithfully,

C. Davidson-Houston

T.Robertson Esq.,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police.
pages.zh:
电话：17121
英国参谋本部
上海
1936年4月27日。

亲爱的 A. Robertson：

获悉一家名为（日语）“Shin Do Kan”的报社出版了一幅新的中国地图。在中文里，这可能是“新道馆”或“新东馆”。

如蒙告知是否听说过该报，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，

C. Davidson-Houston

T. Robertson 先生，
特务科主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY File No. S. B. D. No. Station,）
Special Branch
REPORT
Date May 11, 1936.

Subject Communication dated May 6, 1936 from the Netherlands Consulate-
General on the subject of a Latvian named Bernhard ENGELHARDT.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by L J J Legru

With reference to the attached communicated dated
May 6, 1936 from the Netherlands Consulate-General on the
subject of a Latvian named Bernhard ENGELHARDT, I have to
report that enquiries reveal that this gentleman has no
Police record. Nothing is known that could be construed
as being detrimental to his character from either a criminal,
political or moral point of view.

D.S. Pitts.
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：DSR 11/36）

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 1599.

SHANGHAI, 6th May 1936.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. D. REGISTRY / B. D.）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Bernhard Engelhardt
has applied to this Consulate for a visé for admission into
the Netherlands.

He is in possession of a passport No. 003107 E. issued
by the Latvian Consulate at Shanghai on the 29th December 1931.
According to his passport he was born in Riga on the
24th March 1896.

He is employed by the China United Lamp Co., Shanghai as
a chief accountant and is leaving Shanghai in company of his
wife on the 14th May next on the s.s. "Kulmerland" for Europe
where he will spend his home leave.

He further states that he intends to visit the Philips
Factories in the Netherlands.

He resides in Shanghai at No. 140 Robison Road.

I should be much obliged to you if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known against him from a
political or a moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
（签名）
Chinese Secretary.

T. Robertson, Esquire,
Officer in charge of Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（手写批注：5/2 报）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话挂号：HOLLANDIA。

第1599号。

上海，1936年5月6日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / S. D. 登记处 / B. D.）

先生：

谨通知您，Bernhard Engelhardt 已向本领事馆申请进入荷兰的签证。

他持有1931年12月29日由拉脱维亚驻上海领事馆签发的护照，号码为 003107 E。根据其护照记载，他于1896年3月24日出生于里加。

他受雇于上海中国联合灯泡公司（China United Lamp Co.），担任首席会计师，并将于下月14日与其妻子一同乘坐“库尔默兰”号（Kulmerland）轮船前往欧洲休假。

他还表示打算访问荷兰的飞利浦工厂。

他在上海的住址是罗宾森路140号。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否有任何关于他的不良记录，我将不胜感激。

谨此
顺颂
时祺

您的恭顺仆人，
（签名）
中文秘书。

T. Robertson 先生，
特务科主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（手写批注：5/2 报）
